manifest.name: PowerToys
manifest.description: Triggers Microsoft PowerToys utilities straight from the ring (Color Picker, Always On Top, FancyZones, Screen Ruler, Text Extractor, Peek…). Needs PowerToys installed: the plugin checks the installation and tells you when it or a module is not available.

color_picker.name: PowerToys · Color Picker
color_picker.description: Opens the PowerToys Color Picker to copy the color of any point on the screen.

always_on_top.name: PowerToys · Always On Top
always_on_top.description: Pins (or unpins) the active window above the others.

awake.name: PowerToys · Awake
awake.description: Shows whether Awake is keeping the computer awake. Clicking opens the Awake page in PowerToys settings (the plugin does not change settings).

measure_tool.name: PowerToys · Screen Ruler
measure_tool.description: Opens Screen Ruler to measure distances in pixels.

text_extractor.name: PowerToys · Text Extractor
text_extractor.description: Selects an area of the screen and copies the recognized text (OCR).

peek.name: PowerToys · Peek
peek.description: Previews the file selected in File Explorer (Explorer must be the active window).

shortcut_guide.name: PowerToys · Shortcut Guide
shortcut_guide.description: Shows the Windows keyboard shortcut guide.

find_my_mouse.name: PowerToys · Find My Mouse
find_my_mouse.description: Highlights where the mouse pointer is on the screen.

mouse_highlighter.name: PowerToys · Mouse Highlighter
mouse_highlighter.description: Turns mouse click highlighting on or off.

mouse_crosshairs.name: PowerToys · Mouse Pointer Crosshairs
mouse_crosshairs.description: Turns the crosshairs centered on the mouse pointer on or off.

mouse_jump.name: PowerToys · Mouse Jump
mouse_jump.description: Opens a thumbnail of the screens to jump the pointer to another monitor.

crop_and_lock_thumbnail.name: PowerToys · Crop And Lock (thumbnail)
crop_and_lock_thumbnail.description: Crops an area of the active window into a live thumbnail.

crop_and_lock_reparent.name: PowerToys · Crop And Lock (reparent)
crop_and_lock_reparent.description: Crops the active window, keeping it interactive inside a smaller window.

advanced_paste.name: PowerToys · Advanced Paste
advanced_paste.description: Opens Advanced Paste in the active window.

light_switch.name: PowerToys · Light Switch
light_switch.description: Switches Windows between the light and dark theme.

notInstalled: PowerToys is not installed · install it with: winget install Microsoft.PowerToys

awake.state: Awake · {what}{stopped} · click to open the settings

toast.selectFile: {label}: select a file in File Explorer before triggering it.
toast.noResponseModule: {label} did not respond: the module is not active yet or this PowerToys version does not offer this trigger.
toast.notRunning: PowerToys is not running. Open PowerToys and try again.
toast.startedLate: PowerToys is not running: it was started, but {label} was not available in time.
toast.admin: PowerToys is running as administrator and does not accept triggers from OrbitRing.
toast.settingsFailed: Could not open the PowerToys settings.
toast.disabled: {label} is disabled. Turn the module on in the PowerToys settings.
